plugins.name: thumbgate
plugins.description: Reviewed 👎 feedback becomes local lessons; repeated concrete failures can become reviewable Pre-Action Checks. Critical built-in floors block secrets and unapproved spend before execution.
plugins.longDescription:
ThumbGate adds pre-action checks outside the model's prompt. A thumbs-down captures context and proposes a local lesson; repeated concrete failures can be promoted into reviewable prevention rules. Ordinary learned rules warn by default and can deny in strict mode. Critical built-in floors, including detected secret exfiltration and supported unapproved financial mutations, deny before execution.

The hook evaluates actions routed through ThumbGate in Claude Code and supported agent adapters. It records local evidence so operators can inspect why an action was allowed, warned, or denied. It does not retrain model weights, turn every thumbs-down into an automatic block, or make a same-privilege local agent impossible to bypass.

Financial control requires an explicit positive USD budget and an exact-action requisition approved by an independently authenticated human reviewer. Principal-bound single-use reservations are consumed only at the final allow boundary and settled against receipt evidence. Provider-side limits remain necessary because ThumbGate is not a bank and cannot reverse charges.

Free tier includes local capture and enforcement. Pro ($19/mo) adds the personal local dashboard and exports. Enterprise is intake-first for configured shared-governance requirements; hosted team sync is not a general-availability runtime feature.
